nodes.description: Owner address of Ownable; gate for privileged functions (transferOwnership, stopICO, setRate, mint, finishMinting, issueTokens).
Token balance mapping address => uint256; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and mint.
Nested allowance mapping address => address => uint256; mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Flag gating the canMint modifier; set to true by finishMinting.
MintableToken sold by the crowdsale; target of external token.mint calls.
Sale start timestamp, initialised to block.timestamp in the constructor.
Sale end timestamp, written from block.timestamp in stopICO/buyTokens/issueTokens.
Sale termination flag; set by stopICO, hardcap in buyTokens/issueTokens.
TRU per ETH rate used to compute token amounts in buyTokens.
Accumulated ETH raised in wei.
Cumulative minted token counter used for the hardcap check.
Minimum tokens per purchase (minimumSupply * 10**18).
Constant hard cap of tokens (800000000 * 10**18) enforced before minting.
Total token supply increased by MintableToken.mint.
Ownable constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Public token transfer using SafeMath sub/add on balances.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Public allowance-based transfer; decreases allowance and balances with SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Increases spender allowance with SafeMath.add.
Decreases spender allowance with SafeMath.sub or resets to zero.
onlyOwner canMint function creating tokens and increasing totalSupply.
onlyOwner canMint function setting mintingFinished = true.
Crowdsale constructor: creates token, sets startTime = now and rate.
onlyOwner function setting isFinished = true and endTime = now.
onlyOwner function updating the sale rate.
Internal factory deploying a new AxtrustICOToken.
Payable fallback forwarding all calls to buyTokens().
Public payable purchase: computes tokens, mints, updates tokensMinted/weiRaised and forwards ETH to owner.
onlyOwner function minting tokens for fiat contributions with unchecked *_amount * 10**18.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances, allowances and token minting.
Block timestamp (now) used for startTime/endTime; miner-influenceable.
External ETH transfer owner.transfer(msg.value) executed before finishing state updates in buyTokens.
External call token.mint(msg.sender, tokens) performed before tokensMinted/isFinished are updated.
External call token.mint(_to, amount) performed before tokensMinted/isFinished are updated.
Unchecked multiplication _amount * 10**18 (no SafeMath) that can overflow and bypass the hardcap check.
Unchecked multiplication minimumSupply * 10**18 inside a require in buyTokens.

Initial rate parameter of the crowdsale constructor.
New rate parameter of setRate.

Snapshot of the current allowance used in decreaseApproval.

edges.reason: The Ownable constructor reads msg.sender to initialise the owner address.
Constructor writes the privileged owner state variable from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
newOwner parameter is validated and assigned to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner address, changing all future authorization.
transfer checks and debits balances[msg.sender] for the caller account.
_to parameter selects the credited balances entry.
_value parameter is the amount moved between balances.
balances mapping is updated using SafeMath.sub and SafeMath.add.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried address.
transferFrom authorizes the spender via allowed[_from][msg.sender].
_from parameter is the debited balances entry and allowance owner.
_to parameter is the credited balances entry.
_value parameter is the transferred and allowance-reduced amount.
balances are mutated with SafeMath.sub/SafeMath.add in transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] is decreased with SafeMath.sub.
approve writes its own allowance slot keyed by msg.sender.
_spender parameter is the allowance key being authorized.
_value parameter is stored as the new allowance.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
_spender parameter selects the allowance entry in increaseApproval.
_addedValue parameter is added to the existing allowance.
allowed allowance is increased with SafeMath.add.
_spender parameter selects the allowance entry in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the existing allowance.
oldValue local snapshot of the allowance is read during decreaseApproval.
allowed allowance is reduced via SafeMath.sub or reset to zero.
mint is restricted by onlyOwner (msg.sender == owner) and canMint.
_to parameter receives the newly minted balances entry.
_amount parameter is the minted quantity added to supply and balances.
totalSupply is increased with SafeMath.add(_amount).
balances[_to] is increased with SafeMath.add(_amount).
canMint modifier reads mintingFinished before minting.
finishMinting is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
finishMinting sets the mintingFinished flag to true.
canMint modifier reads mintingFinished in finishMinting.
Constructor reads block.timestamp, making startTime miner-dependent.
startTime state variable is assigned from block.timestamp (now).
_rate constructor parameter is validated and stored.
Constructor writes the rate state variable.
Constructor stores the newly created token contract reference.
Constructor calls createTokenContract() to deploy the token.
stopICO is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
stopICO reads block.timestamp to record the sale end.
endTime state variable is assigned from block.timestamp (now).
stopICO marks the sale as finished.
setRate is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_rate parameter is validated and written to state.
setRate updates the rate state variable used by buyTokens.
The payable fallback forwards every plain ETH transfer to buyTokens().
Any msg.sender can invoke the fallback and therefore the purchase path.
buyTokens uses msg.sender as the token mint recipient.
Local weiAmount is derived from msg.value and used in token math.
Local tokens is computed with SafeMath mul/div from weiAmount and rate.
minimumSupply is read in the buyTokens minimum purchase require.
HARD_CAP_TOKENS is read in the buyTokens hardcap require.
buyTokens accumulates raised ETH into weiRaised with SafeMath.add.
buyTokens increases tokensMinted with SafeMath.add.
buyTokens evaluates the unchecked minimumSupply * 10**18 multiplication.
buyTokens performs the external token.mint(msg.sender, tokens) call.
buyTokens performs the external owner.transfer(msg.value) ETH payout.
External token.mint runs before tokensMinted is updated, so a reentrant token callback can desync supply accounting.
ETH transfer to owner executes before tokensMinted/isFinished writes, allowing reentrant buyTokens executions.
The hardcap isFinished flag is written after the external transfer, so reentrancy can bypass the cap state.
buyTokens reads block.timestamp when the hardcap is reached.
buyTokens assigns endTime from block.timestamp (now) on hardcap.
buyTokens sets isFinished = true when tokensMinted reaches the hardcap.
The token state variable is the call target of the external mint call in buyTokens.
The owner state variable is the recipient of the ETH transfer in buyTokens.
issueTokens is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_to parameter is the recipient passed to token.mint in issueTokens.
_amount parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication _amount * 10**18.
issueTokens evaluates the unchecked multiplication _amount * 10**18.
Local amount holds _amount * 10**18 and drives minting and hardcap checks.
issueTokens performs the external token.mint(_to, amount) call.
External token.mint executes before tokensMinted is incremented, permitting reentrant state desynchronization.
issueTokens increases tokensMinted with SafeMath.add(amount).
HARD_CAP_TOKENS is read in the issueTokens hardcap require.
issueTokens reads block.timestamp when the hardcap is reached.
issueTokens sets isFinished = true when the hardcap is reached.
The token state variable is the call target of the external mint call in issueTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Non-core parameter is only meaningful as the recipient argument of BasicToken.transfer; merge into that core function node.
Non-core amount parameter is consumed by the balances arithmetic inside BasicToken.transfer.
Non-core parameter directly feeds the owner assignment performed by transferOwnership.
Non-core source address parameter only exists to index balances/allowed inside transferFrom.
Non-core recipient parameter is used exclusively by the transferFrom balances update.
Non-core amount parameter controls the SafeMath updates inside transferFrom.
Non-core spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
Non-core allowance value parameter is stored by approve.
Non-core spender parameter selects the allowance entry mutated by increaseApproval.
Non-core added value parameter is the SafeMath.add operand in increaseApproval.
Non-core spender parameter selects the allowance entry mutated by decreaseApproval.
Non-core subtracted value parameter drives the SafeMath.sub branch of decreaseApproval.
Non-core recipient parameter indexes the balances entry credited by mint.
Non-core amount parameter is added to totalSupply and balances inside mint.
Non-core constructor parameter is validated and stored as rate by the crowdsale constructor.
Non-core rate parameter is written to the rate state variable by setRate.
Non-core recipient parameter is forwarded to token.mint inside issueTokens.
Non-core amount parameter is the operand of the unchecked _amount * 10**18 multiplication.
Local weiAmount is a transient copy of msg.value used only inside buyTokens.
Local tokens is the value passed to the external token.mint call in buyTokens.
Local amount is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication and is then minted.
Local oldValue is a temporary allowance snapshot used only for the branch in decreaseApproval.
